title: Finished creative artifacts: mechanisms that became usable tools
summary: A practical branch where research mechanisms crossed into complete runnable creative software. Arborverb and ArborBody package grown waveguide structures as audio plug-ins; AnttisDeepfake turns phase transport into a live generated-portrait puppet; AIvideoFX carries that mechanism into a layered video-effects studio and adds evidence-triggered refresh. The pass records finished artifact status without treating packaging or market plausibility as scientific validation.

nodes.claim: Packages a grown scattering-junction waveguide mesh as VST3/standalone reverb: closed-form decay matching plus an exact adjoint fit for early-reflection and modal-colour structure, while keeping the resulting room body editable.
nodes.survived: The repository contains a complete JUCE plug-in/standalone shell, structural stability tests, finite-difference verification of the adjoint gradient, an end-to-end fit test and measured realtime performance; the fitted object can be moved through, resized and morphed rather than remaining a fixed impulse response.
nodes.killed: It explicitly does not beat convolution at exact static room reproduction, does not claim the underlying waveguide or differentiable-reverb algorithms are novel, and large meshes can become too expensive for live use.

nodes.claim: Packages a grown scattering waveguide body as a VST3/AU/standalone physical-modelling instrument with nonlinear mallet excitation and independently movable strike and pickup positions.
nodes.survived: Eight core verification sections pass, including passive stability, whole-spectrum pitch scaling, velocity-dependent spectral change with a linear negative control, tension nonlinearity, independent pickups, cost measurement and block-size independence; the complete plug-in build is present.
nodes.killed: The waveguide family is not novel, the bodies are intentionally inharmonic, sampled velocity layers can approximate part of the strike behaviour, and continuous bowing is not implemented.

nodes.claim: Carries one generated portrait with live webcam motion using a dense complex Gabor PhaseRail, plus an affine-nullspace appearance constraint, without landmarks, a face mask, optical flow or per-user training.
nodes.survived: The CUDA bank is checked against the numpy reference, a known sub-pixel translation is recovered, the affine projector annihilates an injected affine edit, and the complete interactive studio runs at roughly 17 fps at 128x128 on the development GPU.
nodes.killed: Some visible tracking comes from live low/residual bands rather than proven oriented-phase transport alone; the decisive ablation remains open, large head motion leaves the local-translation regime, unseen anatomy cannot be transported, and correspondence between webcam face and generated portrait is assumed rather than enforced.

nodes.claim: Turns the PhaseRail mechanism into a layered live video-effects studio: person segmentation owns the actor layer, separate prompts generate person and background plates, PhaseRail transports the person, and a causal-refresh controller requests a new keyframe only after persistent structural mismatch.
nodes.survived: The application keeps depth, segmentation, recording and the existing effect chain while separating person/background generation; the causal-refresh controller is implemented as a sibling effect with cheap unit tests in CI and continues transporting the old keyframe while replacement diffusion is running.
nodes.killed: The causal-refresh threshold is still a heuristic rather than a calibrated probability or validated optimum, its human-quality/diffusion-call benchmark remains to be run, and large turns or unseen anatomy still require regeneration or an external portrait-animation system.

edges.why: ArborBody explicitly states that it was made with the arbor line from FunctionalArbors / GeometricNeuronPlusField, turning that grown-structure line into a physical-modelling instrument.
AIvideoFX embeds the AnttisDeepfakeLayer / PhaseRail mechanism as the moving generated-person layer, then adds ownership segmentation, separate generated background and causal refresh around it.
